mostWorthwhile.text: The ending's image of a world continuing to create is a satisfying conclusion to the supplied story.

leastWorthwhile.text: There were no gameplay decisions in the active chapter to assess; it ended immediately.

surprise.text: The active chapter had no goals or items, so there was nothing to play before the ending.

arbitrary.text: No action was available to judge as arbitrary.

continue.text: I would be curious to try a chapter with actual decisions, but this ending alone doesn't establish how engaging those choices would be.
